about_the_game:
Throw the blind samurai into battle!

You are a child traveling with a peculiar blind samurai. One day, the samurai makes you an offer: "Guide me, and I’ll show you a dragon." Intrigued, you agree—and thus begins a strange and epic journey.

Combat

SAMUKID is a deckbuilding roguelike.
Build a skill deck based on dice faces, and collect loot with persistent effects to create the ultimate samurai. Synergize your skills and loot to become even stronger.

Progression

Fight in various battles and events to grow stronger. Face increasingly powerful enemies, and ultimately confront the legendary dragon!

Choose your own path to the dragon! Your decisions lead to intense battles, peaceful moments, or unpredictable events.

Content

SAMUKID offers a wide variety of skills and loot. Find your own combos to defeat hordes of enemies and bosses, and enjoy surprising events along the way.

The legend of the blind samurai and the child begins with you. Embark on this grand adventure now!

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Windows 10 (64-bit)
  • Processor: Intel Core i3-3220 / AMD FX-4100
  • Memory: 4 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GeForce GT 630 / AMD Radeon HD 6670 (2 GB, DX11)
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Storage: 500 MB available space
  • Additional Notes: Runs on most low-end desktops and laptops
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • OS: Windows 10 / 11 (64-bit)
  • Processor: Intel Core i5-3570 / AMD FX-8300
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GeForce GTX 650 / AMD Radeon HD 7750 (2 GB, DX12)
  • DirectX: Version 12
  • Storage: 500 MB available space
  • Additional Notes: Smooth performance with post-processing effects enabled

short_description: A roguelike deckbuilding game where you build a skill deck based on dice faces and collect loot with lasting effects. Create the strongest samurai by combining skills and loot for powerful synergy. The legend of the blind samurai and the child begins with you. Join the start of a great journey!
